name: ai-panel
title: AI Panel
description: The Forge with AI / Build with AI side panel: prompt, Generate, Fix and Explain, a model Select, a running state with an elapsed clock and Thinking and Writing stream boxes, and a result card with a checks badge, evidence, changed files and Apply or Discard. The preview runs against a mock.
notes: ai-panel.tsx is a demo wired to mock.tsx. In your app, import { AiPanel } from "@/components/ai-panel/panel" and drive it from your own backend: set status to running and pass startedAt, then append streamed text to thinking and writing; when the request ends, set status to result and pass result, plus thought for the collapsed "Thought for 1:31" line. Delete mock.tsx once you do.

result.evidence is a slot. The mock shows both kinds from the mockups: dry-run stat tiles (Stat with variant="tiles") and a test-request checklist (AiPanelChecklist). Wrap either in AiPanelEvidence for the eyebrow title.

Ctrl or Cmd and Enter in the prompt runs Generate. Fix and Explain appear only when you pass onFix and onExplain; Cancel only with onCancel. The model picker is the Lantern Select, not a native select.

The panel announces Thinking, Writing and Result ready through one polite live region; the streamed text itself is not announced. Toasts in the demo need the Toaster from the sonner component in your root layout.
